title: Random Loot Block
description: Adds a block that gives a completely random item every time you right-click it.
body:
🎲 Random Loot Block

A simple and fun Minecraft mod that adds a special block which gives a completely random item every time you use it.

✨ What Does This Mod Add?

The Random Loot Block.

Right-click the block and receive a random item from the entire game item registry.

You might get:

Dirt

A diamond sword

A dragon egg

Or something completely unexpected

The block does not break and can be used unlimited times.

⚙ Features

🎁 Right-click to receive a random item

✨ Visual particles and sound effects

💬 Chat message showing what you received

♾️ Unlimited uses

Great for challenges, minigames, and chaos runs

🧱 How To Get The Block

Use the following command:

/give @s randomloot:random_loot_block
📦 Requirements

Minecraft 1.20.1

Fabric Loader

Fabric API

💡 Use Cases

Random challenge runs

Lucky-block style gameplay

Multiplayer chaos events

Content creation

🛠 Compatibility

Fabric only

Server and client compatible

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, feel free to open an issue or leave feedback.

Enjoy the randomness! 🎲
